data.name: Ambient Prologue
data.detailed_description:
Ambient Prologue is a short, atmospheric action-adventure game where you fight powerful magic entities and reveal secrets of the complex world in hooves of 2 princesses.

You play as Krinita, a princess who left her throne to search for the true meaning of life. She found it: in the Great Library she found all she wanted out of life! Fascinating books, games, music from ancient world of humans. However, because of a mysterious catastrophe - the library is lost. And now Krinita is moved by one goal only: to rebuild the Great Library. On this path she'll find strange artifacts, alien technologies and lingering traces of the past.

Designed to be completed in one sitting, the game delivers a tight, memorable experience built around atmosphere, player freedom, and subtle storytelling.

Key Features

  • Exploration-Driven Gameplay
    Navigate interconnected castle halls, discover hidden rooms, and uncover secrets at your own pace.

  • Atmospheric Storytelling
    Narrative unfolds through environments, discoveries, and gameplay rather than exposition.

  • Action & Interactive Mechanics
    Simple but engaging mechanics that evolve as you explore.

  • Optional Secrets & Collectibles
    Players who look closer will find additional layers beneath the surface.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
